Dependable servicefor the systems you count on

When your furnace isn’t heating, your air conditioner isn’t cooling, your refrigerator stops keeping things cold, or an appliance suddenly quits working, you need someone you can trust to take a look.

From no heat and no cooling to an appliance that won’t start, isn’t heating or cooling properly, is making unusual noises, or simply isn’t working the way it should, we’re here to help diagnose the problem and discuss the repair with you.

About us · A family business built on a legacy

The name people trustedstarted with Dale

Our story began in 1967, when Dale Cole of Girard, Illinois proudly opened Cole’s Appliance Repair.

Dale was a hardworking husband, father, grandfather, and a man who took tremendous pride in his work. Through years of dedication, craftsmanship, and genuine care for his customers, he built a reputation that became bigger than a business—it became a name people trusted.

For Dale, doing the job right mattered.

His customers knew they could count on him for dependable service, quality workmanship, fair pricing, and an honest answer. Over the years, that commitment earned him the respect and loyalty of families and businesses throughout Girard and the surrounding communities.

Even after retirement, Dale never lost his passion for the work he loved. More importantly, he passed that passion, knowledge, work ethic, and pride down to his grandson, Tyler.

  • Work hard
  • Do the job right
  • Be honest with people
  • Stand behind your work
  • Treat every customer like family
2024 Midwest Technical Institute graduate

Springfield, Illinois

Continuing the family legacy

Modern training. Time-tested values.

Today, Tyler proudly carries Dale’s legacy forward. Tyler is a 2024 graduate of Midwest Technical Institute in Springfield, Illinois, and a certified HVAC/R technician with training and certifications covering heating, air conditioning, refrigeration, heat pumps, indoor air quality, electrical systems, and gas heating.

Tyler brings modern technical training together with the values his grandfather spent a lifetime building his business around. While Cole’s carries the name and tradition Dale established in 1967, Tyler is also building a reputation of his own through dependable service, quality workmanship, honest pricing, and genuine care for every customer.

The years Tyler spent proudly standing beside Dale helped shape the kind of technician—and the kind of person—he is today. Dale passed down more than technical knowledge. He passed down honesty, responsibility, pride in your work, and a strong work ethic. Those values remain at the heart of Cole’s today.

Cole’s way

More than a service call

We don’t want to be just another company that shows up at your door. We’re your neighbors. For generations, Dale served families throughout the community. Today, Tyler has the opportunity to serve the families of many of the people Dale once helped—and even the next generations of those families.

That makes every service call mean a little more. Dale helped families by passing down his trade to Tyler. Now Tyler is helping carry that same care into the homes and businesses of the families Dale once served. It truly is a family trade, from our family to yours.

A legacy you can trust

From Dale’s first customers in 1967 to the customers Tyler proudly serves today, one thing has never changed: people deserve honest service, honest pricing, and quality care. That is the Cole’s way.
